subject: Mutual Action Plan — initial kickoff draft and two timeline windows (Sagepoint Labs)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Katie Morris <katie.morris@sagepoint.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:23:00 -0400
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — initial kickoff draft and two timeline windows (Sagepoint Labs)

Hi Katie — thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from my side and an initial MAP draft attached for your review. This is intentionally lightweight so we can lock stakeholders and pick a timeline window.

Top-line takeaways from discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and latency for our in-house clinical triage model while keeping telemetry in-house for compliance.
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence, VPC connectivity for model telemetry, and procurement lead time for a dedicated capacity contract.
- Success metric: <20% end-to-end latency reduction at 95th pct and <10% uplift in throughput per GPU.

Attached: Sagepoint_MAP_v1.xlsx (starter draft) and short discovery notes.

Proposed timeline windows (pick one):
1) Aggressive (6 weeks to pilot):
   - Week 1: MAP sign-off + security kickoff (owners: Sagepoint infra, Redwood security)
   - Week 2: Network & VPC setup + test data staging (owners: Sagepoint infra)
   - Weeks 3–4: Integration + pilot smoke tests (owners: Sagepoint ML + Redwood eng)
   - Weeks 5–6: Pilot validation & go/no-go decision (owner: Sagepoint product)
   - Target close: 2027-05-26

2) Controlled (12 weeks phased):
   - Phase A (4 weeks): security review, procurement, and infra prep
   - Phase B (4 weeks): integration + small-scale pilot
   - Phase C (4 weeks): performance tuning and production readiness
   - Target close: 2027-07-05

Milestones (current owner suggestions):
- MAP sign-off: Katie Morris (Sagepoint)
- Security questionnaire & evidence: Rajiv Kapoor (Sagepoint) & Redwood security
- Network connectivity & VPC peering: Rajiv Kapoor (Sagepoint)
- Integration & runbook: Marcus Lin (Redwood) + Sagepoint ML
- Pilot validation & go/no-go: Katie Morris (Sagepoint)

Open dependencies/asks (please confirm):
- Who on the Sagepoint side will own procurement and contract? (we need expected procurement lead time)
- Confirm SOC 2 evidence owner and preferred date for security kickoff
- Confirm stakeholders who must be in the weekly sync (names & emails)

Next steps: please review the attached MAP and respond with (a) which timeline you prefer, (b) stakeholder confirmations (names & emails), and (c) any blocker we missed. If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff this week to finalize owners.

Attachments: [Attachment: Sagepoint_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)], [Attachment: discovery-notes-20270411.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

From: Katie Morris <katie.morris@sagepoint.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Kapoor <rajiv.kapoor@sagepoint.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 13:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — initial kickoff draft and two timeline windows (Sagepoint Labs)

Jordan — thanks for the thorough recap and for getting the MAP draft over quickly. Short answers below and some small edits.

Stakeholder confirmations (internal Sagepoint owners):
- Katie Morris, Head of Product (me) — overall program owner
- Rajiv Kapoor, Director of MLOps <rajiv.kapoor@sagepoint.com> — security & infra lead
- Priya Shah, Procurement Manager <priyaa.shah@sagepoint.com> — procurement/contracts
- Daniel Chu, Clinical Ops (for validation criteria) <daniel.chu@sagepoint.com>

Procurement note: our procurement team typically needs ~3 weeks for a standard reserved-capacity contract (review + sign). That pushes the aggressive 6-week pilot risk unless we run the pilot under a short-term eval clause.

Security: Rajiv will take point on the SOC 2 evidence and wants an initial security kickoff this Thursday (15 Apr) to review what we need.

Map edits / requests:
- Can we move the security review to Week 0 (before network/VPC)? Rajiv insists proof of controls sooner for any infra provisioning.
- Pilot scope: for the canary, Sagepoint wants to limit to 1 model and a 3-VM traffic slice (not full traffic) — can you reflect that in the milestone language?

I attached a one-pager with procurement contact and timeline (not attached in email stub). For next steps, we prefer the Controlled (12-week) window given procurement, but we're open to the Aggressive window if Redwood can provide a short-term eval agreement and we can start security kickoff this week.

Cc'ing Rajiv so he sees the MAP draft notes.

Thanks —
Katie
Head of Product | Sagepoint Labs
katie.morris@sagepoint.com | +1 646 555 0147
